spec: CEO order O-20260928-1630 (reflect on WHY the company cannot saturate CPU; design the RULES and the TECHNICAL BOTTOM properly). Charter = research/SATURATION_DESIGN.md v1.0 (GM-authored reflection + redesign, read FIRST). This ticket implements the EXECUTION-LAYER V2: (D2 FIRST, one-day item) RESIDENT DISPATCHER per machine: watchdog-spawned 30s idle-loop process that claims jobs from its machine's shard, spawns burns, monitors RAM/CPU, reports back -- decouples claim/execute from the 10-min loop (loop keeps governance role: orders scan/ledger/self-check); ignition latency target <=60s from ready (current case: V2-P1 26min). (D1 SECOND, switch after current pool drains) DISPATCH FACE V2: pool file -> read-only job DIRECTORY (one file per batch, append-only claim records), machine ownership = entry-hash static sharding (deterministic owner, zero negotiation zero UU storms); finalize/ledger chain keeps the existing low-frequency pool face. (D3) CONCURRENT-STACK LAW replaces single-burn law: per-machine concurrent burns = min(cores/6, freeRAM_GB/8), process isolation; burn priority BelowNormal -> Normal with INTERACTIVITY VIA CORE AFFINITY SPLIT (loop reserves 2-4 cores, burns take the rest -- yield on demand, not forever); RAM gate = declared-peak-x2 budget per batch (refuse stacking, never refuse burning). (D4) SUPPLY CATALOG GENERATOR: standing catalog of >=100 pre-enumerated job templates (member x window x face x seed robustness matrix + trial-wave chain + v4 precomputes + innovation-quota exploration families); floor-3 auto-enqueue from catalog (engineering of O-1614 supply floor). (D5) BURN KERNEL DENSIFICATION (incremental, per batch): shard-by-construction entries, CSV->parquet panel preload (read once use many), numpy-vectorized cores (GIL-releasing true parallelism), IO/compute phase separation. (D6) merges into T-107 (audit v2.4 + utilization reporting). MIGRATION ORDER: D2 first (kills ignition latency today) -> D1 (switch after current pool drains, backward compatible) -> D3/D4 follow; old pool batches keep running throughout. ACCEPTANCE: ignition latency <=60s (D2), three-machine py>=70% working-hours 3 consecutive days (full), zero UU storms on dispatch face (D1). Anti-dup: T-107 = mechanism layer (audit/floor/SLA/reporting); THIS ticket = architecture layer (dispatch/resident/concurrency/catalog) -- complementary, not overlapping; both serve O-1614 acceptance line.
